What We Do

Services We Offer

From custom kitchen cabinets to deck builds and handyman fixes, we do the work right the first time.

Kitchen Cabinets

Custom-built and installed kitchen cabinets tailored to your space, style, and budget.

Finish Carpentry & Trim

Crown molding, baseboards, window casings, and all finish carpentry details that make a home shine.

Decks & Outdoor Structures

Decks, pergolas, and outdoor structures built to handle the Austin climate and built to impress.

Renovations & Remodels

Full-room renovations and remodels with attention to detail from demolition to final finish.

Custom Closets

Maximize your storage with custom-designed closet systems built specifically for your space.

Custom Garage Storage

Turn your garage into an organized, functional space with custom-built shelving and storage solutions.

Door Installation & Adjustments

New door installs, re-hanging, and adjustments — interior and exterior — done right the first time.

Handyman Services

General Carpentry

All things wood — framing, shelving, furniture repair, and custom builds tailored to your needs.

About Us

Austin Craftsmen You Can Trust

Beech Road Carpentry, LLC is a locally owned carpentry and handyman business based right here in Austin, Tejas. We take pride in honest communication, clean work sites, and results that hold up for years to come.

Whether you're upgrading your kitchen, refreshing your outdoor space, or need a reliable handyman — we show up on time and get the job done right.

How It Works

Simple. Straightforward. Done Right.

Getting started is easy. Here's what to expect when you reach out to Beech Road Carpentry.

01

Call or Text

Reach out by phone or through our contact form. Tell us what you need — no job is too big or too small.

02

Free Estimate

We come out to your home or property, assess the project, and provide a clear, no-obligation written estimate.

03

We Get to Work

Once you're ready, we schedule your project and get it done — on time, on budget, and with care.

04

You're Satisfied

We don't consider a job finished until you're completely happy. Your satisfaction is our guarantee.
